_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG126 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG126.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG126.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG126.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Conclusion-fragment of a commentary on the Gospel of John (Jo 21:22-25 with account of John's death; supplement to the In Joannem)

incipit_checks.incipit: Ἄλλοι δὲ βεβαιοῦνται, ὅτι κυρίως κεκοίμηται, ἤγουν ἐτελεύτησε. Καὶ γὰρ μετὰ Δομετιανὸν ἐβασίλευσε Νερούας, ἔτος ἕν.

works.evidence: Begins imperfectly (title and opening lost with the page break after locus 79's doxology): discussion whether John truly died, Nerva recalling John from Patmos, quotations from Eusebius HE (Polycrates to Victor), exegesis of Jo 21:23-25 lemmata ('Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μαθητὴς...', 'οἶμαι τὸν κόσμον χωρῆσαι τὰ γραφόμενα βιβλία'), closing 'ἵνα συντελέσωμεν ἐνταῦθα καὶ τὴν ἐξήγησιν' with doxology. Distinct from the complete In Joannem ending served in cogPG.PG124.jsonl (its locus 164 doxology differs), so this is the alternate/supplementary ending Migne prints at PG 126, 145-150.
